ob.title: How it works
ob.s1b: Multi-select from the gallery, file picker, drag and drop, paste from clipboard or Android's Share menu. No full-gallery access is requested.
ob.s2: Text is read on your device
ob.s2b: Turkish and English OCR runs inside the browser; your images are not uploaded. The original image is kept unchanged.
ob.s3b: Categories are suggested from keywords; uncertain ones are sent to you for review. Simple, visible rules are learned from your corrections.
ob.privacy: Data lives only in local storage on your device. Clearing browser or app data deletes it; we recommend regular backups.
ob.android: On Android you can add it to the home screen and use it like an app.

set.ocr_enabled_d: Runs on your device with Tesseract; images are not uploaded.
set.ocr_ready_offline: OCR files are ready for offline use.
set.ocr_not_cached: OCR files are not on this device yet (≈17 MB).
set.ocr_prepare_failed: OCR files could not be downloaded
set.ocr_note: Accuracy depends on image clarity; handwriting, tiny or decorative fonts may be misread. You can always edit the text.
set.auto_d: Based on keywords in the recognized text.
set.learn_d: When you change a category, “word → category” rules are created from the image text.
set.threshold_d: Suggestions below this confidence are sent to you for review.
set.rules_empty: No rules yet. They appear here after you correct a category.
set.ai_warn: Off by default. If enabled, only the recognized text (max 2000 characters) and category names — never the image — are sent to the provider you enter. This means data leaves your device.
set.ai_key_d: The key is stored only in this browser, excluded from backups and never bundled in the app.
set.ai_need_key: Enter and save an API key first
set.persisted: Persistent storage granted (the browser can still clear it).
set.not_persisted: The browser may clear this data when space runs low.
set.persist_denied: The browser did not grant persistent storage
set.storage_note: Browser storage is not guaranteed to be permanent: clearing site data or uninstalling can delete everything. Back up regularly.
set.backup_note: ZIP contains original images, text, categories, rules and settings. JSON is text data only (no images). The API key is never included.
set.restore_title: How should the backup be restored?
set.merge_d: Merge: keeps current data and skips identical images (SHA-256).
set.replace_d: Replace: deletes current images, categories and rules first.
set.replace_body: All images, categories and rules on this device will be deleted before restoring.
set.restored: Restored: {n} images added, {d} duplicates skipped, {m} records updated, {bad} problems
restore.err.not_backup: This file is not a Shotrova backup
restore.err.invalid: The backup file is invalid or incomplete
restore.err.newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version; update the app first
set.privacy_body: Shotrova is local-first: no account, no server, no tracking or analytics.
set.privacy_1: Images and recognized text are stored only in local storage (IndexedDB) on your device.
set.privacy_2: OCR runs on your device using files shipped with the app.
set.privacy_3: No data leaves the device unless you enable the optional AI provider.
set.privacy_4: The app only sees images you pick or share.
set.install_1: Open the app in Chrome on Android.
set.install_2: Tap the ⋮ menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
set.install_3: Launch Shotrova from the home screen icon; after the first launch it also works offline.
set.install_4: In the gallery or any app, select an image → Share → Shotrova.
set.install_note: The web app must be installed to appear in the Share menu. The web version (PWA) is not downloaded from the Play Store.
set.about_tech: Built with React, TypeScript and Vite; the Android app is packaged with Capacitor. OCR: Tesseract.js (Apache-2.0).
set.licenses: Open-source licenses: React (MIT), idb (ISC), fflate (MIT), Tesseract.js and tessdata models (Apache-2.0), Satoshi font (Fontshare FFL).
set.wipe_body: {n} images, recognized text, custom categories and learned rules will be permanently deleted from this device. Settings are kept.
set.ocr_bundled: The OCR files ship inside the app, so text recognition works without internet.
set.storage_note_app: Data is kept in this app's private storage on the device and is not backed up to the cloud. Uninstalling the app or “Clear data” erases everything, so back up regularly.
set.install_app: You are using Shotrova as an Android app (APK). In your gallery or any app, pick an image → Share → Shotrova.
set.install_apk: Instead of the web version you can also install the Android app (APK):
